api_and_message_contracts: A visible Ride screen starts a non-exported location|connectedDevice foreground service with the validated dynamic Tripper profile and selected local route.
MapLibre renders an app-owned map and overlays in a Presentation attached to a private VirtualDisplay whose output Surface feeds the existing MediaCodec H.264 encoder.
GPX route geometry and completed offline map packs remain in private app storage; live GPS remains in memory and is not transmitted to the map provider during a ride.
All Tripper DatagramSockets bind to the user-selected Network; inbound control is filtered by configured TFT source IP.
A service-owned session receives location and control packets, updates the renderer on the main thread, handles confirmed joystick actions, and releases resources in reverse dependency order.
The offline map provider receives tile requests for the selected area during preparation. Use an identifying User-Agent, current provider limits, and visible attribution.
Passphrase is session-only; route points, coordinates, encoded frames and full control packets are excluded from logs and analytics.
The TFT identity is not cryptographically pinned and H.264/RTP is not end-to-end encrypted; connect only to a trusted Tripper Wi-Fi network.

review_gates.criterion: PDC, approved spec, evidence sources and acceptance cases agree.
App-owned static test view reaches the target TFT at 526×300 with phone display-off and lock observed separately.
One offline region remains within provider caps and can be cancelled/deleted safely.
Debug APK assembles against SDK 37 without claiming hardware compatibility; current working tree built successfully.
Route map, screen-off/lock, joystick, reconnect, stop and disclosure are validated on the actual bike.
Independent review checks permissions, route/GPS privacy, provider disclosure, cleartext transport and cleanup.

replan_triggers: Presentation/VirtualDisplay does not deliver continuous app-owned frames to the encoder on the target phone.
MapLibre offline APIs cannot enforce the current provider cap before it is exceeded.
OpenFreeMap terms, availability, style or coverage no longer support the intended use.
Tripper FOTA 11.63 rejects the retained K1G handshake or H.264/RTP profile.
Joystick events conflict with observed target-bike behavior.
Android changes alter foreground location, connected-device service, Wi-Fi binding or screen-off behavior.
